messages:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: ALERT — autoscaler stuck in us-east1, GPU queue > 900, throttle engaged. paging oncall: @deepa.

deepa: seeing the alert, joining. can someone paste the queue metrics?

sam: queue growth started ~10m ago, now at ~920. requests/sec up 2.3x. autoscaler status shows pending scale but no new nodes provisioning for ~8m.

nate: confirmed, autoscale controller logs: `error: allocation timeout, quota plugin returned rate_limited`. repeating every 30s.

marcos: ops-bot reports we've hit a soft quota on the pool — GPU reservations can't proceed until quota freed or manual cap bump.

deepa: ok, first step: divert excess traffic off us-east1 to fallback regions (eu-west1 and us-central1) with emergency steer. I'll run manual route policy.

leo: be mindful of model compatibility across regions — some regions don't have the 8-bit quantized variant for rdx-large. fallback should map to rdx-large-legacy which is slightly slower.

deepa: noted. running:```bash
redwoodctl routing set-policy --from-region=us-east1 --to-regions=eu-west1,us-central1 --mode=emergency --weight=0.6,0.4 --ttl=15m
```

ops-bot: route-policy applied by deepa at 3321000300. Now steering ~60% to eu-west1, 40% to us-central1.

sam: traffic shift started. queues in us-east1 stopped increasing but still high (~740) and throttling remains on. latencies for rdx-large in us-east1 95th=4.2s, 503s about 1.5%.

marcos: customer impact: several PLG customers reporting degraded latency and retries, some requests observed as 502/503 during the peak. we should notify CSM for clients > 10k qpm.

deepa: triggering emergency reserve allocation in us-east1 to try and unstick autoscaler while routing change stabilizes.```bash
redwoodctl capacity request-reserve --region=us-east1 --pool=gpu-a100-8 --count=3 --priority=emergency
```

ops-bot: reserve request submitted; provisioning attempt failed: `quota_exceeded`.

nate: since quota bump failing, we need to evict low-priority/resumable jobs to free slots. listing low-priority pools now.

sam: putting eviction plan: cancel background indexing jobs and queued re-runs labeled `low-pri`.```text
Affected jobs: batch-index-3891, eval-grid-202, nightly-cache-warmup
Estimated freed GPUs: 4
```

marcos: +1 to eviction. notify product teams first: @sarah can you DM teams owning those jobs?

sarah: pinged owners, several ok with emergency cancel. proceeding.

deepa: cancelling jobs now.```bash
redwoodctl job cancel --job-ids=batch-index-3891,eval-grid-202,nightly-cache-warmup --confirm
```

ops-bot: 3 jobs cancelled, freed 4 GPUs. pool allocation reattempting.

nate: autoscaler log shows allocation progressing — new nodes provisioning. ETA ~4m. queue trending down to 420.

leo: routing still in place, observed 503s drop to 0.3% in last minute. eu-west1 latency bump but acceptable.

marcos: customer-facing note draft: "Short-term latencies and intermittent errors in us-east1 due to capacity issue. Traffic partially re-routed to other regions; we're provisioning additional capacity and doing controlled evictions. We'll follow up with impacted customers." Send to CSM once I get green.

deepa: provisioning completed at 3321000900. new nodes joined pool; autoscaler cleared pending state. queue now 120 and dropping. disabling emergency steer to return to normal routing.```bash
redwoodctl routing unset-policy --id=emergency-3321000300 --confirm
```

ops-bot: policy unset. routing back to normal over 2m gradual window.

sam: post-check: us-east1 queue steady ~50, 95th latency 250ms. no active throttles.

marcos: good. CSMs notified. will open incident report.

deepa: quick root-cause notes: autoscaler hit quota limit due to stale reservations + a burst of PLG traffic on rdx-large sequences. quota plugin rate_limited prevented allocations; reserve request failed. mitigation: manual eviction freed GPUs, emergency routing prevented broader customer impact, and we ramped reserve once slots freed.

nate: action items: add a preflight quota check and fast-fail path in autoscaler (ACTION-1), add guard to prefer model-variant fallback earlier to avoid heavy allocation (ACTION-2), and update playbook: when quota_exceeded on reserve -> auto-evict tagged-low-pri after N minutes (ACTION-3).

leo: also add a runbook step to verify fallback model variants exist in all regions (ACTION-4).

marcos: I'll schedule a postmortem and assign owners to the actions. tagging ops-bot to create tasks.

ops-bot: created incident ticket INC-332100 with summary "autoscaler quota block + cross-region routing scramble" and tasks for ACTION-1,ACTION-2,ACTION-3,ACTION-4.

deepa: thanks everyone. follow-up: we'll do a dry-run of emergency routing in staging next week. closing thread after notes posted. :white_check_mark:
